name: difftastic
description: Structural diff tool that compares files based on their syntax tree

difft.description: Syntax-aware structural diff tool - compares files based on their syntax tree rather than line-by-line for more meaningful diffs
difft.usage: difft file1.js file2.js\ndifft --display side-by-side old.py new.py\ndifft --color always before.json after.json
